name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for leak damage repair in the Garden City area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for leak damage repair in the Garden City area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for leak damage repair in areas like Garden City, look for licensed, insured, and experienced companies. Ask for references and verify their expertise in water damage restoration. A reliable contractor will provide a detailed estimate and clearly explain the repair plan. Checking their portfolio of completed projects can help ensure they meet local standards and your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured, and experienced contractor with good references for leak damage repair. Verify their expertise and local project history.
